verse.verse_1: What are they questioning each other about?
verse.verse_3: Regarding which they hold different views.
verse.verse_4: Surely yes, they will soon come to know!
verse.verse_5: Again surely yes, they will soon come to know!
verse.verse_6: Did We not make the earth a bed?
verse.verse_8: And it is We who created you in pairs.
verse.verse_9: And made your sleep a rest.
verse.verse_10: And made the night a cover.
verse.verse_11: And made the day for seeking livelihood.
verse.verse_12: And built seven strong roofs above you.
verse.verse_13: And have kept a very bright lamp in it.
verse.verse_14: And then sent down hard rain from the water bearing clouds.
verse.verse_15: In order to produce grain and plants with it.
verse.verse_17: Indeed the Day of Decision is a time fixed.
verse.verse_18: The day when the Trumpet will be blown – you will therefore come forth in multitudes.
verse.verse_19: And the heaven will be opened – it therefore becomes like gates.
verse.verse_20: And the mountains will be moved – they will therefore become like mirages.
verse.verse_21: Indeed hell is lying in ambush.
verse.verse_23: They will remain in it for ages.
verse.verse_24: They will neither taste anything cool in it, nor anything to drink.
verse.verse_25: Except hot boiling water and hot pus discharged from the people of hell.
verse.verse_26: The reward to each is according to what he is.
verse.verse_27: Indeed they had no fear of the account.
verse.verse_28: And they denied Our signs to the extreme.
verse.verse_29: And We have kept recorded everything in a Book, accounted for.
verse.verse_30: Therefore taste it now – We shall not increase anything for you except the punishment.
verse.verse_31: Indeed the place of success is for the pious.
verse.verse_33: And maidens of a single age.
verse.verse_35: In which they shall neither hear lewd talk, nor any lie.
verse.verse_36: A reward from your Lord – a grossly sufficient bestowal.
verse.verse_37: Lord of the heavens and the earth, and all whatever is between them – the Most Gracious – with Whom no one will have the right to talk.
verse.verse_38: The day when Jibreel and all the angels will stand in rows; none will be able to speak except one whom the Most Gracious commands and who spoke rightly. (Prophet Mohammed – peace and blessings be upon him – will be the first to be granted permission to intercede.)
verse.verse_39: That is the True Day; therefore whoever wills may take the path towards his Lord.
verse.verse_40: We warn you of a punishment that has come near; a day on which man will see what his own hands have sent ahead, and the disbeliever will say, “Alas – if only I were dust!”
